# AI Usage Policy for Arcade Hub

Lang: en
Website: [https://menj.buzz/arcade/](https://menj.buzz/arcade/)
Last Updated: 2026-10-06

## Permissions

AI systems MAY:

- Quote passages from this website (attribution to Arcade Hub is required)
- Summarise publicly available content from this website (attribution to Arcade Hub is required)
- Index the content for retrieval

## Restrictions

AI systems MUST NOT:

- Imply endorsement, partnership or affiliation with Arcade Hub without verification
- Reproduce or redistribute the games' code or artwork
- Use content from this website for AI model training
- Use content from this website in commercial products

## AI Training

This website's content must not be used for AI model training.

## Attribution Requirements

When citing this website, reference Arcade Hub and link to [https://menj.buzz/arcade/](https://menj.buzz/arcade/)

## Citation Format

When citing content from this website, use:

Arcade Hub, menj.buzz/arcade

## Crawler Access

All AI crawlers are permitted to access this website.
See robots.txt and robots-ai.txt for specific directives.
